findings.description: Owen Morris's parents were John Morris, a farmer born about 1818 at Llanilar, and Dorothy Morris, born about 1825 at Llanfihangel; the 1871 census lists him, aged about 12 and born at Llanbadarn-Fawr, as a farmer's son in their household at Lower Llanbadarn-y-Croyddin, Cardiganshire.

target_person.name: John Morris and Dorothy Morris
target_person.father: John Morris, farmer, born about 1818, Llanilar, Cardiganshire
target_person.mother: Dorothy Morris, born about 1825, Llanfihangel, Cardiganshire

supporting_sources: England and Wales, Census, 1871 — household of John Morris, Lower Llanbadarn-y-Croyddin, Cardiganshire: John (farmer, b. ~1818 Llanilar), wife Dorothy (b. ~1825 Llanfihangel), sons Owen (b. ~1859 Llanbadarn-Fawr), Evan (b. ~1868) and James (b. ~1871)
